UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within the application. It stores user-specific information and their assigned roles.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login.

displayName.description: A user-friendly name for display purposes.

isAdmin.description: Flag indicating if the user has administrative privileges.

isActive.description: Flag indicating if the user's account has been activated by an admin.

passwordChangeRequired.description: Flag indicating if the user must change their password on the next login.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: Represents an invitation for a new user to join the application.

email.description: The email address of the user being invited.

invitedAt.description: The timestamp when the invitation was sent.

/userProfiles/{userId}.description: Stores individual user profiles. The document ID (`userId`) MUST be the user's Firebase Authentication UID.

/invitations/{invitationId}.description: Stores pending invitations sent to new users. These are deleted upon successful account creation.
